scope: Snapshot of existing local queues, not all Discord messages or all years. Separate tour/server-image searches are not added to these counts because their references may overlap.

tracking.messageIdentity: Discord channel ID + message ID; preserve original UTC timestamp and source URL.
tracking.imageIdentity: Discord attachment ID (or source-derived ID for external images), plus local SHA-256 where available.
tracking.resumeRule: Skip image IDs already reviewed unless unavailable, ambiguous, changed, or reopened by a new source. Read nearby messages for unresolved context; do not equate visual review with accepted WR status.
tracking.completionRule: Neither a final WR, a reconciliation report nor a message count certifies exhaustive history. Every appearance remains unverified until source coverage, images, nearby context, competitors and open leads are reconciled.
